summary: Additive box-type feature verified end-to-end. Backend /api/settings returns rate_beer=16 & rate_brandy=18; /api/inventory returns by_type. UI: BoxEntry has entry-boxtype-select with Beer/Brandy; Brandy qty 1200 -> waste 100 kg saved & shown in table with Box Type column. Invoices modal item-desc-0 is a select; selecting Brandy autofills rate=18, Beer autofills rate=16; invoice created successfully (AP601, total 1888). Inventory /inventory shows inventory-by-type with type-card-Brandy-Bottle-Cotton-Box (had 1 entry). Settings rate_beer/rate_brandy fields load, save and persist across reload. Test data cleaned up.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' emitted by a dev-tool wrapper injecting <span x-ve-dynamic> inside <option>. Non-blocking dev-time warning (likely from x-file-name JSX instrumentation), not a functional bug.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1000 lines and could be split into routers/services modules for maintainability.

Invoices.jsx item-desc select maps only whitelisted BOX_TYPES via `value={BOX_TYPES.includes(it.description) ? it.description : ''}` - fine, but consider persisting non-standard legacy descriptions if any pre-existing invoices carry them.

The <option>{shop_no}·{name}</option> composite text with dev wrapper triggers React console warning about <span> in <option>; the source JSX itself is valid, so no change needed unless the JSX instrumentation is removed in prod build.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up: 1 Brandy box entry (1200 pcs) and 1 invoice AP601.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All box-type additive requirements (BoxEntry select + column, Invoices item-desc select with auto-rate, Inventory by_type cards, Settings rate_beer/rate_brandy persistence) pass. Only cosmetic React dev-warning about <span> inside <option> due to JSX instrumentation wrapper; not a functional issue.
